# UIAnimationSystem

*Client*

An animation of a script UI component, from [`animation`](/scripting/client/ui/ScramUIBuilder#animation): more steps can follow it, and it can repeat or run code when it ends.

## Methods

### afterAnimation {#afteranimation}

::: member

Chains another animation of the same component that starts when this one ends.

```js
ui.animation("title", "intro", "sine_out", 0.5, function (label, p) {
    label.ry(p * 0.3);
}).afterAnimation("sine_in", 0.5, function (label, p) {
    label.ry(0.3 - p * 0.3);
}).repeat();
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, like `"linear"` |
| `delay` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in seconds |
| `consumer` | `Function<UIComponent<?>,Double>` | function called every frame with the component and the progress, 0 to 1 |

**Returns** [`UIAnimationSystem`](/scripting/client/ui/systems/UIAnimationSystem) — this animation

:::

### afterAnimation {#afteranimation-2}

::: member

Chains another animation with linear progress, see [`afterAnimation(String, float, BiConsumer)`](#afteranimation).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `delay` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in seconds |
| `consumer` | `Function<UIComponent<?>,Double>` | function called every frame with the component and the progress, 0 to 1 |

**Returns** [`UIAnimationSystem`](/scripting/client/ui/systems/UIAnimationSystem) — this animation

:::

### onCompleted {#oncompleted}

::: member

Calls a function when the animation ends; with [`repeat(int)`](#repeat), after the last repeat. A cancelled animation does not call it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `consumer` | `Function<UIComponent<?>>` | function that gets the component |

**Returns** [`UIAnimationSystem`](/scripting/client/ui/systems/UIAnimationSystem) — this animation

:::

### repeat {#repeat}

::: member

Plays the animation and its chain a number of times in total.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `repeatCount` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | how many times it plays |

:::

### repeat {#repeat-2}

::: member

Plays the animation and its chain again and again, until it is cancelled with `ui.cancelAnimation(id)`.

:::
